purpose: Test one outcome-informed but runtime-label-free refinement of V176: retain its exact all-or-none rejection when at least two heavy incomplete-parent terminal players coexist, and reject a lone heavy terminal only when the current queue has crossed the already-frozen routing threshold 8 and its immutable CPU work is at most two current mean-node frame capacities. The lower queue boundary avoids speculative terminal work under genuine backlog; the upper CPU boundary avoids the long-service starvation exposed by V177 E18.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

causal_diagnosis.supported: V177 proved that queue density alone is not a sufficient lone-heavy rejection predicate. Its beneficial E06 windows all rejected a lone terminal with normalized CPU work 1.3126459121704102, whereas every harmful E18 rejection had normalized CPU work between 2.0573408603668213 and 2.6016173362731934 and increased mean latency by 8.403374609744979 ms. V170 telemetry also shows that an unqualified CPU-at-most-two rule would fire hundreds of times while the queue is below the scheduler's established routing boundary, including 247 E14 windows at queue density 0.05 to 0.45. The smallest defensible two-dimensional refinement is therefore to require both real backlog, queue density at least 8, and bounded lone-terminal work, normalized CPU strictly above one and at most two.
causal_diagnosis.queue_threshold_rationale: 8 is the frozen SRPT/Hiku2-versus-OCS routing threshold already used by the scheduler; it is not fitted between seed outcomes.
causal_diagnosis.cpu_upper_boundary_rationale: 2 is the natural integer boundary of at most two current mean-node frame capacities; it lies below every harmful E18 lone-heavy observation and above every beneficial E06 observation without using a seed, DAG or function label.

single_mechanism_change_from_v176.unchanged_primary_activation: activate the exact V168 all-or-none CPU guard when current heavy incomplete-parent terminal player count is strictly greater than one
single_mechanism_change_from_v176.new_bounded_single_activation: also activate when the current heavy player count equals one, current operational queue density is at least 8, and the lone heavy player's immutable CPU work divided by current cluster mean node CPU capacity is at most 2
single_mechanism_change_from_v176.inactive_single_behavior: retain exact V159 terminal admission when queue density is below 8 or the lone heavy normalized CPU work is above 2
single_mechanism_change_from_v176.active_rule: reject every current heavy incomplete-parent terminal player and admit no such heavy player

bounded_single_definition.heavy_terminal_definition: terminal function, at least one incomplete direct parent, and immutable function.cpu divided by current cluster mean node CPU capacity strictly above one
bounded_single_definition.inactive_comparison: heavy_terminal_player_count == 0 or heavy_terminal_player_count == 1 and either operational_queue_density < 8 or lone_heavy_normalized_cpu > 2
forbidden_runtime_inputs: DAG ID, function ID or request ID

mechanism_only_seed_selection.source: frozen V170 E01-E20 nash_metrics telemetry plus V177/V178 result-disclosed structural telemetry
mechanism_only_seed_selection.positive_selection_rule: select every V170 seed with at least one exact-one heavy window satisfying queue density at least 8 and normalized CPU at most 2
mechanism_only_seed_selection.negative_control_rule: also execute E09 and E18 because every observed lone-heavy CPU ratio is above 2; E09 covers moderate queue and E18 covers the V177 harmful severe-queue regime
mechanism_only_seed_selection.selection_scope_note: performance is used only to formulate this training candidate and is sealed before execution; the runtime predicate contains no outcome or identity field

valid QC, ledger, archive inventory, runtime identity and offline reference pairing
primary guard active for every heavy count above one exactly as V176

diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_selected_nine_paired_gate: at least seven selected seeds beat paired OCS
diagnostic_selection_rule.full_throughput_gate: mean strictly greater than Orion 1.4741 and at least 12 of 20 wins
diagnostic_selection_rule.full_qpr_gate: both QPR means strictly greater than OCS 0.055577160345697, at least 12 of 20 wins, and all twenty finite
